title: Quick Pro UR One Full Review in Beijing, China! The Best Chinese Road Bike I’ve Ridden?

takeaways.text: Repeats Quick Pro's T1200 frame claim of 630 g in size M and a 30 mm tire limit; the bike was a Beijing Quick store demo.
Store prices in May 2026: CNY 27,998 with Shimano 105 Di2, CNY 31,698 for the Ultegra 'Ultra' build and CNY 53,998 with Dura-Ace.
The 105 Di2 complete bike with 50 mm wheels weighed 7.1 kg with flat pedals; frame size was not stated.
On a short ride in street clothes without power data, the presenter found it comfortable, very responsive and quick to hold speed, and needed little fit adjustment.

disclosure: The channel page lists Lameda and Light Bicycle as partners with discount codes; no model-specific supply statement was established for this video.
summary: Exact UR One review and ride context retained on the research-stage profile. Public captions were unavailable, and the video does not verify a current mainland price or exact sale configuration.
